content.question: How do I report a power outage?
content.answer: You can report an outage by calling our contact center and selecting the "Report an Outage" option from the menu.

content.question: What information do I need to report an outage?
content.answer: You may need: Your name, Service address, Account number (if available), Description of the issue.

content.question: How can I check the status of a reported outage?
content.answer: You can check outage status through the automated system or speak with an agent for updates.

content.question: How long will it take to restore power?
content.answer: Restoration times vary depending on the cause and severity of the outage. You will receive an estimated restoration time if available.

content.question: Should I report an outage if my neighbors also have no power?
content.answer: Yes. Even if neighbors are affected, reporting helps us confirm the scope of the outage.

content.question: What should I do during a power outage?
content.answer: Turn off major appliances, Keep refrigerator/freezer doors closed, Avoid downed power lines, Report the outage immediately.

content.question: How do I report a downed power line?
content.answer: Stay away and call immediately to report it as an emergency.

content.question: How do I transfer my electricity service to a new address?
content.answer: Contact us and select the "Move Service" option. Provide your current and new service address.

content.question: How far in advance should I request a move?
content.answer: We recommend contacting us at least 3–5 business days before your move date.

content.question: How do I disconnect my electricity service?
content.answer: Call the contact center and select "Disconnect Service." Provide your account and disconnection date.

content.question: Is there a fee for moving or disconnecting service?
content.answer: Fees may apply depending on your service agreement.

content.question: Can I schedule a same-day disconnection?
content.answer: Same-day requests depend on availability and service policies.

content.question: What happens to my deposit when I disconnect service?
content.answer: Your deposit (if applicable) may be refunded after your final bill is processed.

content.question: How do I request a new electricity connection?
content.answer: Call the contact center and select "New Connection." Provide your personal and property details.

content.question: What documents are required for a new connection?
content.answer: You may need: Valid ID, Proof of property ownership or lease agreement, Contact details.

content.question: How long does it take to activate a new connection?
content.answer: Activation times vary but are typically completed within a few business days.

content.question: Is a security deposit required for a new connection?
content.answer: A deposit may be required depending on credit history and service policies.

content.question: Can I apply for a new connection online?
content.answer: If online services are available, you may submit your request digitally or through the contact center.

content.question: How can I pay my electricity bill?
content.answer: You can: Use Self Assist automated payment, Speak to an agent, Use available online payment options.

content.question: What payment methods are accepted?
content.answer: Common payment methods include: Credit/debit card, Bank transfer, Online payment systems.

content.question: Can I set up a payment plan?
content.answer: Yes. Speak with an agent to discuss available payment arrangement options.

content.question: What happens if I miss a payment?
content.answer: Late payments may result in late fees or service disconnection if unpaid.

content.question: How can I check my current bill amount?
content.answer: Use Self Assist to hear your balance or select Agent Assist for detailed billing support.

content.question: Can I get a copy of my bill?
content.answer: Yes. An agent can provide billing details or resend your statement if available.

content.question: How do I submit my meter reading?
content.answer: Select the "Submit Meter Reading" option and provide the reading from your meter.

content.question: When should I submit my meter reading?
content.answer: Submit your reading on or before your scheduled meter reading date.

content.question: Where can I find my meter reading?
content.answer: Your meter reading is displayed on your electricity meter, typically located outside your property.

content.question: What happens if I don't submit my meter reading?
content.answer: Your bill may be estimated based on previous usage.

content.question: Can I correct a submitted meter reading?
content.answer: Yes. Contact an agent as soon as possible to correct the information.

content.question: Why is my bill higher after submitting a meter reading?
content.answer: A higher bill may reflect: Increased electricity usage, Previous estimated readings being adjusted, Seasonal consumption changes.
